evidence_quote: So, each dog eats 1 kg of food per day.
question_evidence_quote: Each one eats 250 grams of food per day.
observed_error: The response assigns the combined daily consumption of all four dogs to each individual dog.
violated_condition: Each dog eats 250 grams daily; 1 kilogram daily is the total for all four dogs.
error_description: After correctly calculating and converting the four dogs’ combined daily consumption, the response labels that 1 kilogram as each dog’s daily consumption. This violates the stated 250 grams per dog per day and causes the subsequent 14-day calculation to multiply by four a second time.
